load_mjcf_humanoid: load an MJCF humanoid robot XML file into a PyBullet simulation using p.loadMJCF
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to a PyBullet physics simulation in GUI mode using p.connect with p.GUI
add_debug_parameter: add an interactive debug slider parameter for gravity or joint control using p.addUserDebugParameter
control_joint_motor: control a humanoid joint position using p.setJointMotorControl2 with POSITION_CONTROL and a target position
change_joint_dynamics: set linear and angular damping on a humanoid body or joint using p.changeDynamics
